remote_monitor_disconnect_on_stream_end.description: Remove the client's extra monitor when its stream finishes. Leave this off to keep the monitor ready for Resume.
remote_monitor_disconnect_on_stream_end.label: Remove it when the Remote Monitor stream ends

remote_monitor_disconnect_on_client_disc.description: Remove the extra monitor as soon as the client connection drops or you use Disconnect, even if the monitor was waiting for Resume.
remote_monitor_disconnect_on_client_disc.label: Remove it when the client disconnects

remote_monitor_terminate_on_first_reques.description: Moonlight needs Vibepollo to advertise the host as available to extra clients so it can show the running game and Terminate control. Leave this off to require launching Terminate twice; the original game client is not affected.
remote_monitor_terminate_on_first_reques.label: Terminate on the first request

remote_monitor_confirm_app_replacement.description: Reject the first request to replace a running app, then advertise it as resumable for 60 seconds so Moonlight can show its close-app warning. Remote Input and Remote Monitor still attach without that warning. Turn this off to replace apps immediately.
remote_monitor_confirm_app_replacement.label: Confirm before replacing a running app

capture.description: Automatic follows the host’s capture policy. Supported Linux machine hosts use direct KMS capture. Override only for compatibility.

encoder.description: Automatic follows the configured display adapter, or the dedicated GPU with the most video memory, then verifies the encoder before streaming.

fec_percentage.description: Adds recovery packets to each video frame. The 20% default handles ordinary packet loss; higher values use more bandwidth.
fec_percentage.label: Network recovery (FEC)

frame_limiter_disable_vsync.description: Controls the manual limiter. Automatic virtual-screen game smoothness temporarily disables VSYNC while its pacing policy is active.

frame_limiter_enable.description: Apply the configured limiter to every stream. Virtual screens already use a matching limiter automatically while automatic game smoothness is enabled.
frame_limiter_enable.label: Always limit rendered frames

frame_limiter_auto_virtual_framegen.description: Automatic keeps the virtual screen at 4× refresh and changes only WGC's latest-frame admission: 2× on the desktop and 4× for a confirmed game. This avoids display-mode changes while retaining high-rate game capture. Compatibility keeps the older fixed 2× behavior.
frame_limiter_auto_virtual_framegen.label: Virtual-screen game smoothness
frame_limiter_auto_virtual_framegen.description_linux: Automatic keeps the virtual display at 4× the requested stream rate and caps launched games to that rate with the selected Linux limiter. Compatibility uses a fixed 2× virtual-display rate.

frame_limiter_provider.description: Used by manual limiting and automatic virtual-screen game smoothness. On Linux, Automatic uses the frame-generation-capable Proton limiter and presents MangoHUD; on Windows it prefers RTSS, then NVIDIA Control Panel.

frame_limiter_fps_limit.description: 0 follows the stream rate. A nonzero value also replaces the automatically calculated virtual-screen limit.

output_name.description: Leave blank to let Vibepollo choose the display. Otherwise use an exact device name.

port.description: Choose the base TCP and UDP port for Moonlight and the Web UI. WAN access exposes the Web UI to the internet.

rtss_frame_limit_type.description: This mode applies to physical-display streams. Virtual displays use NVIDIA Reflex unless the opt-in virtual-display override is enabled.
rtss_frame_limit_type.label: RTSS SyncLimiter mode

rtss_allow_virtual_display_override.description: Virtual displays normally enforce NVIDIA Reflex because DLSS Frame Generation can otherwise add significant latency. Enable this only to apply the selected RTSS mode to virtual displays; mark a DLSS/FSR game as Frame generation -> Game provided to force Reflex for that app.
rtss_allow_virtual_display_override.label: Allow non-Reflex RTSS modes on virtual displays
rtss_allow_virtual_display_override.warning: Warning: Async, Front-edge Sync, Back-edge Sync, or any other mode besides NVIDIA Reflex can cause massive latency when a game uses DLSS Frame Generation. You are accepting that trade-off for virtual-display streams.

rtss_install_path.description: Leave blank to detect the RTSS installation folder automatically. RTSS is ready when its hooks are present.
rtss_install_path.label: RTSS installation folder

virtual_display_layout.description: Choose whether physical displays remain part of the host desktop while streaming.
virtual_display_layout.label: Local monitors while streaming

virtual_display_mode.description: Choose whether Vibepollo captures a physical monitor or creates a display sized for the client.
virtual_display_mode.label: Streaming display

wgc_slot_aligned_publish.description: Publish only the Windows capture frames the host will actually use. Turn it off to publish every admitted frame.
wgc_slot_aligned_publish.label: Slot-aligned capture publishing

wgc_direct_encoder_input.description: Encode each Windows capture frame directly instead of copying it first. This lowers encode latency. Turn it off to use the previous copy path.
wgc_direct_encoder_input.label: Direct Windows capture input

wgc_pacing_smoothing.description: Reduce visible pacing changes when Windows Graphics Capture is active.
wgc_pacing_smoothing.label: Smooth Windows capture cadence

frame_generation.automatic: Automatic — always 4× display; desktop WGC capped at 2× / games at 4× (recommended)
frame_generation.off: Off — no automatic virtual refresh or WGC admission limit

frame_generation.compatibility_linux: Compatibility — 2× virtual display; cap games to the stream rate
frame_generation.off_linux: Off — no automatic virtual-display refresh or game cap

overrides.empty_description: For example, use 3840x2160 on the streaming display when the client requests 2560x1440.
overrides.final_refresh: Use this refresh rate on the host
overrides.final_required: Choose the resolution or refresh rate to use on the host.
overrides.final_resolution: Use this on the streaming display
overrides.hint: When a client requests one resolution, use another on the streaming display. Common resolutions appear as you type; rules are checked from top to bottom.
overrides.inactive_description: Resolution overrides are not applied while both resolution and refresh behavior are fixed or preserved.
overrides.invalid_saved_description: The saved value is not in the supported three-list format. It has been preserved unchanged so these controls cannot silently replace it. Correct it in the configuration file before editing substitutions here.
overrides.invalid_saved_title: Saved resolution overrides could not be read
overrides.manual_description: A fixed resolution or refresh rate takes priority for that part of the display mode. Overrides remain active for each value set to Match the client.
overrides.manual_title: A fixed display mode is active
overrides.policy_conflict_description: The automatic-refresh and fixed-refresh rule lists contain different behavior for the same resolution. Preserve those policy-specific rules in Advanced Display settings, or make them agree before using the simple editor.
overrides.policy_unsynced_action: Use these substitutions with every refresh policy
overrides.policy_unsynced_description: Existing resolution rules differ between automatic and fixed refresh behavior. You can keep managing them separately in Advanced Display settings, or explicitly make the simple substitutions apply to both.
overrides.refresh_error: Enter a refresh rate greater than 0 and no more than 1000.
overrides.requested_fps_error: Enter a whole-number requested frame rate from 1 to 1000.
overrides.refresh_optional: Also match or change the frame rate
overrides.requested_fps: When the client requests this frame rate
overrides.requested_required: Choose the client resolution this substitution should match.
overrides.shadowed_description: An earlier advanced rule may match before one of these substitutions. Review rule order in Advanced Display settings if the shown substitution does not take effect.
overrides.shadowed_title: An advanced rule may take precedence
overrides.simple_hint: When the client requests one resolution, deliver another instead. These substitutions continue to work with automatic or fixed refresh behavior.

recovery.checking_detail: Checking the saved display recovery baseline.
recovery.create_confirm: Save the current Windows display layout as the golden recovery snapshot?
recovery.hotkey_detail: When Vibepollo runs in your Windows desktop session, use this shortcut to restore the session baseline, fall back to the golden layout when needed, remove virtual displays, and stop recovery. Service-mode installs may not receive desktop shortcuts.
recovery.hotkey_invalid: Use F1–F24, a letter, or a number as the main key.
recovery.hotkey_modifier_required: Include Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Win so ordinary typing cannot trigger display recovery.
recovery.hotkey_listening: Listening — press the shortcut you want to use.
recovery.hotkey_unsafe_detail: This saved shortcut could trigger during ordinary typing. Add Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Win, or replace it with the recommended shortcut.
recovery.not_created_detail: Save the physical desktop layout Vibepollo should recover when normal session restoration is unavailable.
recovery.prefer_golden_detail: Use this known-good layout first whenever Vibepollo restores the desktop. If it cannot be restored, Vibepollo falls back to the session snapshot.
recovery.prefer_golden_unavailable: Create a recovery snapshot to make a known-good desktop layout the default. Session-based restoration remains available as the fallback.
recovery.ready_detail: A known-good physical display layout is available as the final recovery fallback.
recovery.refresh_recommended_detail: The saved layout is old or has accumulated repeated restore failures. Update it while the physical desktop is arranged correctly.
recovery.replace_confirm: Replace the golden recovery snapshot with the current Windows display layout?
recovery.snapshot_error: The golden recovery snapshot could not be saved.
recovery.snapshot_requested: Snapshot capture was requested. The status will refresh after the display helper finishes.
recovery.status_error: The golden recovery snapshot status could not be loaded.
recovery.unavailable_detail: Vibepollo could not read the golden recovery snapshot status.

windows_display.description: Reports the driver observed by the host after its most recent runtime check.
windows_display.error_body: The host could not refresh virtual-display status. The last observation is still shown.

ready.title: Driver responded
ready.description: {driver} responded to the latest runtime check and is ready for virtual-display use.

failed.title: Driver is unavailable
failed.description: {driver} did not respond to the latest runtime check. Repair or reinstall the driver before using a virtual display.

uninitialized.title: Driver has not been initialized
uninitialized.description: The host has not initialized a virtual-display driver yet. Start a stream or restart Vibepollo, then check this status again.

version_incompatible.title: Driver version mismatch
version_incompatible.description: {driver} reported an incompatible protocol version. Repair or reinstall the driver to match this Vibepollo build.

watchdog_failed.title: Driver watchdog failed
watchdog_failed.description: {driver} stopped responding to its watchdog. Repair or reinstall the driver before starting another virtual-display stream.

unknown.title: Driver status is unknown
unknown.description: The host has not reported a valid virtual-display driver observation. Check the host service and try again.

windows_display.observed_unknown: Observed by host: no driver result yet
windows_display.dummy_plug_title: The Disable VSYNC override is required for the dummy-plug HDR workaround
windows_display.dummy_plug_description: While this workaround is enabled, Vibepollo forces the Disable VSYNC override on and locks it. Disabling the workaround leaves your saved VSYNC choice unchanged.
windows_display.vsync_forced: Required by the active physical dummy-plug HDR workaround. The Disable VSYNC override is shown as enabled and cannot be changed until the workaround is disabled.
windows_display.next_step: Start a stream or restart Vibepollo to produce a fresh runtime check.

linux.title: Display readiness
linux.recommendation: Virtual screens match your client's resolution and refresh rate automatically.
linux.explanation: A virtual screen provides smooth frame delivery and low capture latency. Automatic resolution and refresh matching keeps it in sync with your client.

reasons.driver_or_outputs_unavailable: The virtual-screen driver or its managed outputs are unavailable. Check the Linux installation before selecting a virtual screen.
reasons.session_or_output_unavailable: The desktop session or virtual output is not ready. Check the session and display setup.
reasons.unknown: The host could not verify its virtual screens. Check the Linux setup and try again.

linux.greeter: Pre-login streaming uses one shared virtual screen. Logging in ends this stream; reconnect to stream your desktop. Desktop preferences apply after login.
linux.audio: Linux uses the managed virtual audio sink automatically. Change audio routing only when you need a specific device.
linux.unverified: The host is reachable, but streaming readiness has not been verified yet.
linux.check_setup: Check display and encoder readiness in Settings, or open Logs for the reported failure.

fields.virtual_display_mode: Virtual screens are recommended for the lowest capture latency and smoothest frame delivery. Use a screen per device, share one screen, or select a physical monitor.
fields.virtual_display_layout: Choose what happens to your local monitors during streaming. Using only the virtual screen turns off the other displays until the desktop is restored.
fields.capture: The supported Linux machine host uses KMS for direct virtual-screen capture. Other backends are compatibility overrides and may not support unattended streaming.
fields.adapter_name: Leave empty for automatic GPU selection. To select a render device explicitly, enter its Linux path, such as /dev/dri/renderD128.
fields.virtual_display_outputs: Leave empty to use the managed virtual-screen pool. Explicit DRM connector names are an advanced override.

settings.leave_warning: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?
settings.reset_warning: This restores the desktop and clears saved display state. It can interrupt the current stream.
